title: Sassy Browser public smoke scoreboard
method: Honest engineering assessment from README capability matrix, DataROOM metrics, and Mercury/render audits — not a fresh automated crawl of every URL on this date. Re-run before claiming improvements.

legend.pass: Usable for the site's primary read/browse task in current builds
legend.partial: Loads or partially renders; major layout/JS/interaction gaps remain
legend.fail: Primary experience broken or SPA hydration requirements unmet

sites.notes: Simple static document; baseline smoke that historically worked when complex pages failed.
Mostly HTML list UI; readable with layout/CSS gaps vs Chromium. Cited in render-collapse investigations.
Search shell loads; historically hit render-collapse / zero-width layout bugs. Interactive search UX incomplete.
Heavy SPA; JS/DOM gaps dominate. Not a support claim for GitHub.com workflows.
0.13.1 included Google render-hang fixes (CSS attribute indexing + connection storm dedup). Results UX still far from Chrome.
Article text generally reachable; chrome, media, and interactive elements incomplete.
Modern MDN requires broader web-platform surface than current SassyScript/DOM coverage.
Marketing pages often readable; richer interactive sections vary.
Document-ish pages may load; player/search SPA surfaces incomplete.
Mostly static forms/lists; better fit for current engine than SPA giants. Form edge cases still possible.
